slot.intent: Three figures tell the collapse: 4.2bn in revenue, a loss of 900m, and 12,000 staff gone.

concept: Each figure lands large and counts up as it is said, then docks into a row above, smaller and grey, as the next is named; the last, 12,000 staff gone, stays large and lands red.
storyboard: 0.0 s, on "Revenue": REVENUE builds in small tracked caps below the middle of the frame, where the first figure will land above it
1.45 s, on "4.2bn,": 4.2bn lands large in bold JetBrains Mono and counts up from zero, slowing into its value by 2.15 s
2.5 s: the revenue figure docks into the row above, shrinking and stepping back to grey as it glides, home as "loss" is spoken at 2.9 s and LOSS builds in its place
4.35 s, on "900m,": 900m lands large and counts up the same way, home by 5.05 s
5.4 s: the loss figure docks beside revenue in the row above, clear of the middle as 12,000 lands large at 5.8 s and counts
6.5 s: 12,000 settles to red as its count lands and STAFF GONE builds beneath it; a full hold to the end, the last figure left large

leansOn.title: Stat counter (this channel's approved version)
leansOn.why: One heavy mono figure counts up from zero and settles to red with no pale edge left round it; labels in small tracked caps.
